columns.description: Sandy soil with minimal clay content

requires_capabilities: Custom soil texture specification per column

Vegetation type and LAI held constant across all simulations (e.g., C3 grass or temperate deciduous forest)

Bedrock depth and soil column depth identical across all columns
No lateral subsurface flow - pure 1D vertical water movement
Topographic slope set to zero to eliminate topographic runoff effects
No irrigation or other anthropogenic water inputs
Soil hydraulic parameters derived from texture using standard pedotransfer functions
Initial conditions: 19-year simulation provides adequate equilibration from cold start
Climate period 2000-2018 provides diverse precipitation patterns for robust partitioning analysis
Groundwater table dynamics allowed to equilibrate naturally based on soil properties
No frozen soil parameterization differences - focus on liquid water partitioning
